question: Which portions may be assigned in the third division using a seventh share?
premises: A seventh share is the unit
Rudra and Bhānu portions are options
The assignment applies in the third case
inference: In the third division, one may assign either a Rudra portion or a Bhānu portion by a seventh share.
plain_english: In the third case, by a seventh share, one may take the Rudra portion or the Bhānu portion.
